description: Defines the VendorMessageSlave class responsible for handling vendor-specific message exchanges via broker in a network device context. Includes method declarations for initialization, message sending, and handling received CMDU messages, as well as external references to broker clients and event loops.

classes.name: VendorMessageSlave
classes.description: Manages vendor-specific message exchange with broker, including initialization, message sending, and handling received CMDU messages.

methods.name: VendorMessageSlave
methods.description: Constructor initializing the VendorMessageSlave with broker UDS path and event loop.

methods.name: send_cmdu_to_controller
methods.description: Sends a CMDU message to the controller via broker.

methods.name: should_stop
methods.description: Checks if the message handling should stop.

methods.name: handle_cmdu_from_broker
methods.description: Handles incoming CMDU messages from broker, filtering based on MAC addresses.
